Aku akan membawamu ke neraka. Jika itu yang dibutuhkan untuk membakar dan memotong semua Nursefather... Maka ya, Aku dengan senang hati akan menjadi jurang maut bagi kalian untuk membuang setiap rahasia buruk yang ingin kalian lupakan dan hilangkan.
Jadi datanglah. Di dasar jurang itu... terdapat seluruh diriku dari semua cabang, menunggu agar pedang ini memotong kalian semua.

Aku lahir di sini dan dirawat olehmu, atau aku hanyalah produk terikat yang lahir dan dipelihara dengan sendirinya?
Bagiku, ini adalah perbedaan tanpa kelainan. Di duniaku, fajar berkokok dan malam bersinar pada detak yang sama... Bahkan gelombang cahaya matahari dan ruang waktu melewati tubuhku.

Rumah ini, sangat luas dan sempit secara bersamaan, offers everything needed to sustain a life. Hearty food to fill my belly every meal, pillows dan bedding soft enough to enjoy a nap, dan even amusements fit for pastimes.
But that's where it stops. That's all there is. Not a single thing... worth leaving my heart behind for.

In these vile, revolting moments, I am again dan again dragged before sights I wish I'd never have to recall. What would it have been like, I wonder, if I was spared such torture when I close my eyes dan beg for sleep?
If only that'd been the case... then perhaps I would never have grown to abhor the inescapable promise of nightfall.

I've thought of leaving, once. Wanted to tear myself free from the House of Spiders, even if it meant I'd be doomed to wander aimlessly through the endless Corridors. But in the end, all the freedom in the world won't give me the happiness dan liberation I crave.
Not so long as I escaped the House with the Nursefathers still alive dan kicking.

I banged dan banged on that door more times than I could count, trapped between moments that came entangling in all their horrendousness... until an awful realization dawned on me—that while I was the only one who could open the Time Vault, there was nothing stopping any Nursefather of the House of Spiders from keeping it locked.
Even my intuition dan perspective in sensing the flow of time gave me no reprieve. In the end... I became helplessly entangled beyond any hope of undoing the threads.

I am... waiting still, even now. In this place no one can escape from—a place ever suspended, ever barred from touching the sky... Waiting for the day when I will slash dan scorch through the Nursefathers until they are severed away. How I yearn for that moment.

I'm the only one who always deserved to cry. Not a single day passed that I didn't want to weep from the moment I first learned what the Nursefathers wanted from me.
And that's why... none of you are allowed to shed even a single drop of tear! Not from sorrow, not from joy, not for any reason at all! You have no right... to cry.

Jika emotion is the only thing that remains, dan the memory itself no longer exists... Could I finally lay down this hatred? No, that is impossible. Not when every thread that has entangled with my world is shaking with the intent to kill. And so nothing must be allowed to remain here. Not memory, not time, not even the heart to hold them. That is the ending you, who have made me into who I am, dan I, will meet.
La... lala... lala... lala...

I will cut down every one of you across every world... Scrape every last trace of you out of reality...
And then, I alone will hold all that has been severed... It's nothing more than a return to a state of Arayashiki.
Aku tidak dapat bebas dari sini. Tidak tanpa memutuskan benang laba-laba...
Aku akan memutus mereka semua. Para Nursefather, House of Spiders, semua yang telah dan akan terjadi.
... Detak jam ini, juga, akan hilang pada waktunya.
Seperti yang terlukis.
Semakin aku potong...
Jangan sekarang... Aku tidak ingin kembali dulu...
... Apa kebencian akan hilang?
Bahkan dalam kematian... Ini tidak akan terputus...
This is hardly a challenge compared to the homework I've done so far.
*puff* "SMH," was it.

Isn't it only fair that you Nursefathers despair just as much as I have resented? Let us forget all. Erase all. I will forget dan erase myself, dan you too, will be forgotten—ripped out from the world until not even a trace of you remains.

It's... not... over yet. Soon... soon, I'll become the bottomless well just like you wished in your deepest desires—the abyss where everything dan anything can be ground beyond the veil of oblivion. And when I do, you'll be the first in line to be cast into me, all of you in the House of Spiders... Yes, you, the rejects of your own homes... Your own families want nothing more than to forget about you... Haha... Hahaha...
